censusScope: The census is taken over the WHOLE fifteen-page bundle, because its AcroForm is bundle-wide and the fill runs on the whole bundle. A field with at least one widget on a delivered page carries a dictionary entry; a field whose every widget is on a page this family does not deliver is listed separately and is declared unwritable to the finalizer.
captionBasis: The AcroForm field names the Coalition authored, checked against the printed text of a page each field sits on. `printedCaptionFound` records whether that exact string was found; where it is false the printed line at the widget's own coordinate is recorded beside it. See reports/caption-evidence.json.
